senses.gloss: [to split, enter into, cmp. בָּדַק) to examine, investigate.
units: <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 306:18-21">Sifré Deut. 306</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 32:2">Deut. XXXII, 2</cite>) <he>מה שעירים … ומְפַשְׁפְּשִׁין בהם וכ׳</he> as the rains come down upon the plants and cleanse and permeate them &c.; <he>כן הוי מְפַשְׁפֵּשׁ וכ׳</he> so do thou enter into the words of the Law &c.; Yalk. ib. 942.

<cite ref="Berakhot 5a:9">Ber. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>אם רואה אדם … יְפַשְׁפֵּשׁ במעשיו</he> if man sees that troubles are coming upon him, let him investigate his conduct; <he>אם פ׳ ולא מצא וכ׳</he> if he has investigated and can find nothing (wrong) &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 1:1:16">Y. Keth. I, 25ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>אם בשפי׳ ומצא וכ׳</he> if it be a case when he searched and found (tokens of virginity) &c.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 25:6">Ex. R. s. 25</cite> <he>בשר ודם מְפַשְׁפֵּשׁ שטרותיו</he> a human being examines his papers. Tanḥ. Ḥuck. 6 <he>חקרתי ושאלתי ופִשְׁפַּשְׁתִּי</he> I searched and inquired and investigated.
<cite ref="Tosefta Shekalim 2:1">Tosef. Shek. II, 1</cite> <he>מְפַשְׁפְּשִׁין בו וכ׳</he> they searched him on entering (the treasury) and on leaving.
<cite ref="Tosefta Yevamot 14:8">Tosef. Yeb. XIV, 8</cite> <he>מפשפשין באותה העיר</he> investigation is held in that town.
<cite ref="Tosefta Negaim 6:7">Tosef. Neg. VI, 7</cite> <he>צא ופַשְׁפֵּשׁ בעצמך וכ׳</he> go and examine thyself (thy conduct) and do repentance; a. e.
